description: This file defines a React component for a Categories Page in a storefront admin UI. It includes functions for fetching, filtering, and displaying category hierarchy data, along with UI rendering logic.

classes.name: CategoryTreeNodeView
classes.description: React component for rendering individual category nodes in a tree view, with support for expandable details and developer info.

methods.name: getCategoryDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a display name for a category, prioritizing description name, code, or a default label.

methods.name: normalizeRoots
methods.description: Normalizes category roots, especially when a single root with children is returned.

methods.name: filterTree
methods.description: Filters category nodes based on a search query, recursively including matching nodes and their children.
